Incoterms 2020

Caderno ATA

An international customs document permitting the temporary admission of goods (e.g., exhibition samples, professional equipment) without duties or taxes.

Quick answer: An international customs document permitting the temporary admission of goods (e.g., exhibition samples, professional equipment) without duties or taxes.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Caderno ATA?

In this glossary, Caderno ATA refers to: An international customs document permitting the temporary admission of goods (e.g., exhibition samples, professional equipment) without duties or taxes.

How is Caderno ATA used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A equipe de filmagem usou um caderno ATA para trazer câmeras profissionais temporariamente para a França."

Why does Caderno ATA matter in logistics?

Caderno ATA matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Caderno ATA?

Caderno ATA is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Caderno ATA belong to?

In this glossary, Caderno ATA is grouped under Incoterms 2020. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An international customs document permitting the temporary admission of goods (e.g., exhibition samples, professional equipment) without duties or taxes.

Operational example

The film crew used an ATA Carnet to bring professional cameras into France temporarily for a festival shoot.
